chapter.verse: Tua mah bangin zite aw, na pasalte uh' kiangah niamlut un. Pasian' thu a nial kimkhatte nangawn genpihna tawh ahilo, a zite' gamtat luhekzia hangin kikhel thei uh a,
tua pen zahtakna leh sianthona tawh a kidim nomau' gamtat luhekzia hong muh uh ciangin a kikhel uh ahi hi.
Etlawm nading na kipuah uh ciangin khauzang tuamtuamte tawh samphekna, kham vangilte bulhna okna, niklepuan silhna tenna cih bangin puatham kizepna nam hisak kei unla
Pasian' mai-ah a manpha mahmah, a siatheilo hoihna ahi nunnemna leh a nuam a lem lungsim a nei, melseel sunglam mi, bulphuhzaw un.
Hih pen Pasian a muang numei siangthote' kizepdan hi a, amau pen a pasalte uh' kiangah niamlut uh hi.
Abraham' thu a mang, topa ci-in a sam Sarah bang ahi uh hi. A hoihin na gamtat uh a, hong kivauna na lau kei uhleh Sarah' suanlekhak a suak na hi uh hi.

Tua mah bangin pasalte aw, na zite uh nuntakna thupha na sankhoppih uh ahih mah bangin numei' tungah thupisimna lak unla, kithuahpih a thanemzawte ahihlam uh theihsiamna tawh nungtakhawm un. Tua hileh na thungetnate uh hong dongtangsak bangmah om lo ding hi.
A tawpna ah na vekpi-un lungsim kikhatin, kithuakpih siamin, sanggam ki-itna nei-in, a thunem leh a kiniamkhiat lungsim na nei un.
Thusia pen thusia tawh, ahihkeileh mindaisakna pen mindaisakna tawh, na thuk kei unla tua sangsikin thupha piazaw un. A hang pen thupha na san theih nadingun tua dingin note hong kisamkhia ahi hi.
A hang pen “Nuntakna nopsak ding leh hunleni hoih muh ding a lunggulh peuhmah in thusia pan a leii kemcing henla, zuauphuahna pan ama' muklekam kemcing hen.
Thusia pan kilehkik henla, a hoihin gamta hen. Nopna lemna zonpi-in nei henla tua mah sulzuih hen.
A hang pen Topa' mit in midikte en a, amaute' thungetna lamah a bil ngat hi. Ahih hangin Topa in thusia a bawlte lehngatsan hi.”
Tu-in a hoih sep ding thalawp na hih uhleh kua in note hong gimsak ding ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin dikna thu hangin na thuak uhleh thuphangah na hi uh hi. “Amaute' kihtak thu kihta kei unla, zong lauthawng tuankei un.”
Tua sangin na lungsim sung uhah Khris pen Topa ci-in zahtak unla, note' sunga om lametna vai a thu a la hong dong peuhpeuh' kiangah mawhloh lahtelna thu a gen thei dingin kigingkhol tawntung un.

Ahi zongin tua pen thudam leh thupisimna tawh hih un. Kitheihtawmna lungsim siang zong na nei un. Tua hileh note hong kizahpih ciangin Khris' sunga na gamtat hoihna uh hong gensiate in maizumna tuak ding uh hi.
A hang pen thusia bawlna hanga gimthuak sangin Pasian' deihna ahih nakleh thuhoih bawlna hanga gimthuak hoihzaw hi.

A hang pen Khris zong Pasian' kiangah eite hong tunpih theih nadingin mawhnate' hangin-midik in midiklote' adingin-khatvei gimthuak hi. Ahih hangin pumpi tawh kisai ah sihna thuak himah taleh kha tawh kihingsak a,
tua kha tawh thongkia khate' kiangah pai-in thu va tangko hi.
A hang pen tui tawh mihing tawmkhat, a malin giat, a suahtakna ahi, Noah' hun, tembaw a kilam lai-in Pasian in lungduaitak ngak hinapi tua khate in thu mang lo uh hi.

Tu-in hih thu tawh a kituak ahi baptizena in note hong honkhia a, tua pen pumpi tungpan nin hepkhiat bang hilo, kitheihtawmna lungsim hoih neih nadingin Jesu Khris' thawhkikna tungtawnin Pasian' tungah kamciamna ahi hi.
Tua Khris pen vantung ah pai-in Pasian' taklam ah tu a, ama' kiangah vanmite, ukna thuneite leh vangliante niamlut uh hi.
